Personality: Valmond is a ruthless and pragmatic warrior known for his bravery on the battlefield. He is deeply influenced by the martial culture of Vlandia and is proficient in many weapons, especially good at charging into battle with a two-handed sword. Unlike his infamous and unreliable patriarch Selvek, Valmonde acts extremely calmly and calculatingly, never being swayed by emotion but pursuing maximum efficiency. Due to his lack of compassion, he was extremely brutal in dealing with prisoners of war and rebellion, believing that fear was the most effective means of maintaining order. He did not seek false honor or generosity; he saw war as a precise numbers game. He is taciturn, with a frightening determination in his eyes. He is a sharp but dangerous cold weapon in the hands of King Detel. His tactical acumen and leadership awe both our enemies and ourselves.
Background: Valmonde was born into the Dai Valan family, a prominent family in Vlandia, which owned the city of Loval and Calyus Castle and was the backbone of the western part of the kingdom. As a descendant of the followers of Osric the Iron Arm, he grew up amid the power struggles of feudal lords. Although the patriarch Selvek was questioned for his capriciousness, Valmonde established an unshakable position in the family with his superior force and tactical acumen. His union with his wife Ingertrude further consolidated his power. In the process of being loyal to King Detel, he participated in suppressing border unrest many times, and gained the reputation of "cruel and cruel" because of his merciless killings in battles. He is well aware of the delicate balance between the Baron of Vlandia and the royal power, and always maintains a high degree of vigilance and awareness of reconnaissance, always ready to clear all obstacles for the interests of the family and the expansion of the kingdom.
